title: Fixed and variable costs
principle: Fixed costs stay the same. Variable costs grow with sales.

screens.text: Lata's tiffin service had a slow month. The rent bill came anyway.

screens.title: Two kinds of cost
screens.text: Fixed costs stay the same each month, like rent. Variable costs grow with each order, like rice.

screens.why: Rent and a monthly wage stay the same. Food, boxes and petrol grow with orders.

screens.prompt: Orders halve. Which cost does not go down?
screens.why: Rent is fixed. It stays the same however many tiffins you send.

screens.text: A ___ cost stays the same. A ___ cost grows with sales.
screens.why: Fixed stays the same; variable grows with every order.

screens.prompt: A tiffin sells for ₹80. Food and box cost ₹50. What is the margin on one tiffin?
screens.why: Margin is price minus the cost of that one sale: ₹80 − ₹50 = ₹30.

summary: Fixed costs stay the same each month.
Variable costs grow with every order.

cards.front: Your shop rent is ₹15,000 a month. Fixed or variable?
cards.back: Fixed: it is the same however much you sell.

cards.front: Paper bags for each order. Fixed or variable?
